name: KG Eco Solution Co.,Ltd.
summary: KG Eco Solution Co., Ltd. is primarily involved in waste management, providing a range of collection and treatment services. The company's business activities are categorized into three main departments: Energy Resources, New Materials, and Recycle & Eco. The Energy Resources division is responsible for gathering resources and producing steam. The New Materials department manufactures and supplies products such as copper oxide, sulfate pentahydrate, and basic carbonate. Furthermore, the Recycle & Eco department handles the recycling of both general and specific waste types. The organization was established on October 29, 1999, and operates its main office from Siheung-si, South Korea.
